description: This PHP file defines the class 'TemplateDynamicenum', which extends 'TemplateEnum' and is used to manage dynamic enumeration fields in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for obtaining field definitions and rendering edit options, and sets specific properties related to dynamic enum types.

classes.name: TemplateDynamicenum
classes.description: A class representing a dynamic enumeration field type within SuiteCRM, extending 'TemplateEnum' with additional properties and methods for handling dynamic enum options and rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the class, sets up inheritance, and maps the 'parentenum' property to 'ext2'.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array, setting the database type to 'enum' and determining the 'parentenum' value based on class properties.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Generates an array of template variables for editing this field, including options, help text, and current value.
